contact.name: <Full Name>
links: <other contact-section item, e.g. a profile link or link text, exactly as it appears>

headline: <title line under the name, or null>

companies.name: <Company Name>
companies.start_date: <YYYY-MM | YYYY: earliest role start at this company>
companies.end_date: <YYYY-MM | YYYY | Present: latest role end at this company>
companies.company_summary: <the resume's own sentence about the company, verbatim, no tags like (AI Startup), or null>
companies.role_summary: <non-bulleted line describing your overall remit at this company, verbatim, or null>

bullets.text: <bullet with no clear position also goes under the most recent role>

education.degree: <degree type only, e.g. Bachelor of Science, or null>
education.field_of_study: <field split from 'X in Y', e.g. Computing & Software Systems, or null>
education.graduation_date: <as written in the resume, or null>
notes: <bullet under this entry, or honours/awards like (Dean's Award), verbatim>

additional_information.title: <volunteer / project / teaching / advisory title, or null>
additional_information.text: <the entire entry verbatim, including any heading line and bullets (one per line)>

unclassified: <any resume text that fits nowhere else, verbatim>
